scope: Retained kind 35129/15129/5129 events returned by this relay with completed lookup. Not a global census; no public event or moderation state was changed.

sourceAmendment.meaning: Intentional addition of NIP-34 nostr clone URLs to source; does not replace the selected baseline or certify all proposed media/archive fields.

interpretation.audio-session-review: Static AudioContext/media-element lead, not a conformance verdict. Confirm use and negotiated session/control handling.
interpretation.bundled-fetch-review: Static call site. May be dead dependency code or a byte/URL overload. Do not label direct networking required without execution evidence.
interpretation.currentFormatMigration: Legacy releases should be migrated by their author, not rewritten or retroactively treated as failed current-format publications.
interpretation.intentional-proposed-source-extension: Source uses the intentional Nostr URL extension proposed in dskvr/nips PR 12. Outside the selected baseline URL schemes; not a publisher defect or playback/security failure merely because of its scheme. Full amendment conformance is not certified.
interpretation.outside-selected-source-url-schemes: Literal baseline difference, recorded separately from the justification and practical impact of an extension.
interpretation.nip5d-nostr-source: Informational source extension usage. Keep optional source resolution separate from artifact verification and playback.
interpretation.soy.app-data/1: Documented application convention over NIP-78 and existing OUTBOX/RELAY operations, with optional host-policy discovery. Presence alone is not a defect; test sharing support/denial and graceful degradation separately.
